items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: I just really appreciate you thinking of me, and Denis thinking of me.

ctx.x: I did. We might have to do part two down the road.

That’s fine, and I’ve got more stories for you if you need — I just really appreciate you thinking of me, and Denis thinking of me. So it’s always an honor to talk about my — this helps keep his legacy alive. And that’s the thing that’s very — tell me about your school and tell me about your archives if you can.
Well Hamilton College is a very old college. It goes back to the early 1800s. It’s a liberal arts school. It’s small. It’s a gorgeous place, a nice place to work.
